blocks.prompt: 9. A hiker pulls a sled using a rope that exerts a force of 80 newtons over a distance of 25 meters. The total work done is 1200 joules. At what angle to the direction of motion is the force being applied?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Section 10.3 ka real-life sawal hai jo aakhir mein ek seedhi trigonometric equation \(\cos\theta = \ldots\) ban jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Force 80 N, fasla 25 m, aur kul work 1200 J.
Find kya karna hai? Rassi (force) aur chalne ki simt (direction of motion) ke darmiyan angle.
Plan: work ka formula \(W = Fd\cos\theta\) lagayein, \(\cos\theta\) nikalein, phir \(\cos^{-1}\) se angle.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(F = 80\) N, \(d = 25\) m, \(W = 1200\) J.
Maloom karna: force aur motion ke darmiyan angle \(\theta\).
Tareeqa: Jab force motion ke saath angle \(\theta\) banaye to work \(W = Fd\cos\theta\) hota hai. Wajah: force ka sirf woh hissa \(F\cos\theta\) kaam karta hai jo motion ki simt mein hai; ooper ki taraf wala hissa sled ko aage nahi le jata. Jaise rassi tirchi kheenchne par kuch zor sled ko ooper uthane mein lagta hai.

Values rakhein
\[1200 = 80 \times 25 \times \cos\theta\]
\[1200 = 2000\cos\theta\]
Kyun: \(80 \times 25 = 2000\). Agar rassi bilkul seedhi (\(\theta = 0^\circ\)) hoti to poora 2000 J work hota; yahan sirf 1200 J hai, is liye angle zaroor 0 se bara hai.

\(\cos\theta\) nikalein
\[\cos\theta = \dfrac{1200}{2000} = 0.6\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 2000 se divide kiya taake \(\cos\theta\) akela reh jaye.

Angle nikalein
\[\theta = \cos^{-1}(0.6)\]
\[\theta \approx 53.13^\circ\]
Kyun: Kheenchne wali force aur motion ka angle \(0^\circ\) aur \(180^\circ\) ke darmiyan hota hai, aur is range mein \(\cos\theta = 0.6\) ka sirf ek hal hai: \(\cos^{-1}(0.6)\).
Dhyan dein: Calculator degree mode mein hona chahiye, warna jawab radians (0.927) mein aayega.

Tasdeeq
\[2000\cos 53.13^\circ = 2000(0.6) = 1200\]
Kyun: Wapas rakhne se wohi 1200 J work milta hai, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\theta \approx 53.13^\circ\)
Yani rassi chalne ki simt se takreeban \(53^\circ\) ke angle par kheenchi ja rahi hai.
